description_en: Restarts a single node of a MongoDB instance
name: RestartNode

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

If the instance is a sharded cluster instance, also set the `NodeId` parameter
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。 
如果是分片集群实例，您还需要配置`NodeId`
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Mongos, shard, or Configserver node in the sharded cluster instance. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62010.html operation to query the node ID.

This parameter is required if DBInstanceId is set to the ID of a sharded cluster instance
parameters.help_zh:
分片集群实例中Mongos节点ID、Shard节点ID或ConfigServer节点ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62010.html接口查询Mongos节点、Shard节点或ConfigServer节点的节点ID。

当DBInstanceId配置的是分片集群实例ID时，需要配置该参数
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en:
The role ID of the node.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468469.html operation to query the role ID of a node in a replica set instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468472.html operation to query the role ID of a node in a sharded cluster instance
parameters.help_zh:
节点的角色ID.

可以调用 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468469.html 接口查询副本集实例的节点ID。
可以调用 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468472.html 接口查询分片集群实例的节点ID
parameters.name: role_id

parameters.help_en:
The time to execute the task. Valid values:

0: The task is executed immediately. This is the default value.

1: The task is executed during the maintenance window.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473775.html operation to modify the maintenance window of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
执行时间，取值：
0：立即执行，默认值。
1：在可维护时间段执行。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473775.html修改实例的可维护时间段
parameters.name: switch_mode
